author: Steve Jobs
quote: Stay hungry, stay foolish.

author: Linus Torvalds
quote: Talk is cheap. Show me the code.

author: Alan Turing
quote: We can only see a short distance ahead, but we can see plenty there that needs to be done.

author: Grace Hopper
quote: The most dangerous phrase in the language is, 'we've always done it this way.'

author: Donald Knuth
quote: Premature optimization is the root of all evil.

author: Edsger W. Dijkstra
quote: Simplicity is prerequisite for reliability.

author: Ada Lovelace
quote: The more I study, the more insatiable do I feel my genius for it to be.

author: Tim Berners-Lee
quote: The web does not just connect machines, it connects people.

author: Bill Gates
quote: Your most unhappy customers are your greatest source of learning.

author: Dennis Ritchie
quote: The only way to learn a new programming language is by writing programs in it.

author: Socrates
quote: The only true wisdom is in knowing you know nothing.

author: Aristotle
quote: Knowing yourself is the beginning of all wisdom.

author: Marcus Aurelius
quote: You have power over your mind, not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.

author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quote: He who has a why to live for can bear almost any how.

author: Confucius
quote: It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.

author: Lao Tzu
quote: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.

author: Immanuel Kant
quote: Science is organized knowledge. Wisdom is organized life.

author: Seneca
quote: We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.

author: Soren Kierkegaard
quote: Life can only be understood backwards; but it must be lived forwards.

author: Plato
quote: The measure of a man is what he does with power.

author: Klein Moretti — The Fool
quote: I am the Fool who does not belong to this era, the mysterious ruler above the gray fog, the King of Yellow and Black who plucks the strings of fate.

author: Klein Moretti
quote: Calm... be calm. This is just an ordinary situation.

author: Klein Moretti
quote: Roll the dice. The result is in the hands of fate — but the choice is mine.

author: Roselle Gustav
quote: Today's diary entry: the world is a stage, and even gods are merely actors who forgot their lines.

author: Alger Wilson — The Hanged Man
quote: Faith is the lantern. Caution is the road. Without one, you stumble; without the other, you walk in darkness.

author: Audrey Hall — Justice
quote: A lady never panics — she observes, weighs, and then strikes with absolute composure.

author: Emperor Roselle
quote: Knowledge is the most dangerous Beyonder ingredient of all. Swallow it carefully, or it will digest you instead.

author: The Fool
quote: Above the gray fog, the undefined and unrecorded — that is where I stand, and that is what I am.
